request.description: A natural four-legged WALK cycle IN PLACE facing right, WITH LARGE SYNCHRONIZED WING FLAPS. Both wings unfold upward and outward, sweep DOWN TOGETHER showing membrane undersides, fold edge-on and recover. Clearly visible wing motion, not rigid wings or a small twitch. Alternate diagonal weight-bearing paw pairs with bending joints, shoulders and hips rise and fall, tail balances. No takeoff, sliding, bipedal pose or rearing. Preserve the exact supplied creature, life stage, face, horns or crest, colours, anatomy and fine scales or feather edges. Sharp detailed sprite, no chunky enlarged pixels or blur. Fixed right-facing camera, same size and position, complete silhouette with clear canvas padding throughout. Transparent background, no floor, shadow, rider, saddle, text or new objects. No grey blobs, beige patches or opaque scraps in gaps between wings, horns and back. Seamless loop.
